title: WorkFactory: Turning Professional Intents into Executable Work for Scalable Agent Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.37161v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scaling supervised training for working agents requires diverse professional tasks that yield reliable expert demonstrations. However, missing or inconsistent task information can obstruct teacher execution and weaken the resulting supervision. We propose WorkFactory, a scalable framework for constructing coherent and executable professional tasks. Starting from professional intents, information-level planning builds an information support graph to guide task instantiation, explicitly representing the dependencies and locations of information required for the intended outputs. Probe executions then identify support failures and guide repairs while preserving the intended work. We construct 112,686 tasks spanning 612 occupations and use the collected teacher trajectories to fine-tune Qwen models at 4B, 27B, and 35B-A3B scales, yielding the WorkPilot family. translated_title: WorkFactory：将专业意图转化为可执行工作以实现可扩展的智能体训练
translated_abstract: 扩展智能体的监督式训练需要多样化的专业任务，以产生可靠的专家演示。然而，缺失或不一致的任务信息可能会阻碍教师模型的执行，并削弱由此产生的监督信号。我们提出了 WorkFactory，一个用于构建连贯且可执行的专业任务的可扩展框架。该框架从专业意图出发，通过信息级规划构建信息支持图来指导任务实例化，显式表示预期产出所需信息的依赖关系和位置。随后，探针执行（probe executions）用于识别支持失败并指导修复，同时保留预期的工作内容。我们构建了涵盖 612 个职业的 112,686 个任务，并利用收集到的教师轨迹对 4B、27B 和 35B-A3B 规模的 Qwen 模型进行微调，得到了 WorkPilot 系列模型。这三个模型在四个专业基准测试中均超越了各自的基础模型。
tldr: WorkFactory 通过信息级规划和探针执行，将专业意图转化为连贯可执行的任务，构建了覆盖 612 个职业的 11 万余个任务，并据此训练出在专业基准上超越基础模型的 WorkPilot 系列智能体。
en_tdlr: WorkFactory is a scalable framework that converts professional intents into coherent, executable tasks via information-level planning and probe executions, constructing 112,686 tasks across 612 occupations to train the WorkPilot agent family, which outperforms base models on professional benchmarks.
